answer: Splitting into 2 separate vaults requires a separate funded grove account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The plume explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the river binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 250 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
